title: Higashiyama on Foot
blurb: Walk Higashiyama under the real sun: up Yasaka-dori to the pagoda, through the stone lanes of Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka, to the stage of Kiyomizu-dera and the view Conan fans come for.

weather.source: Kyoto: Japan Meteorological Agency, 1991-2020 normals, days with at least 0.5 mm

surfaces.name: Kiyomizu-dera, the Stage 清水の舞台
surfaces.label: the Stage

surfaces.name: Kiyomizu-dera, the West Gate's steps 西門
surfaces.label: the West Gate

npcs.name: Aiko 愛子
idle: Half the girls in kimono on these lanes rented them from a shop like mine. The other half are from Kyoto and laugh at us.
Dusk is the hour: the lanterns come on and the pagoda goes dark against the sky.

npcs.name: Mr. Fujii 藤井
idle: Kiyomizu-yaki: pottery from these slopes since the 1600s. Chawan-zaka, the Teapot Lane, is named for it.
Mind your step on Sannenzaka. They say if you fall here you'll be unlucky for three years.

npcs.name: Ryosen 良仙
idle: The Deva Gate is the temple's red front door. The two guardians: one with his mouth open, one closed. A and Un, the beginning and the end.

npcs.name: Mika 美香
npcs.role: Detective Conan fan on a pilgrimage
idle: 真実はいつもひとつ! One truth prevails. I've done Gojo Ohashi and Rokkaku-do already; Kiyomizu is the big one.
The view I need is from the Okunoin: the whole stage on its pillars, like in the film.

quests.title: The pagoda at the top of the street
talk: おこしやす, welcome to Higashiyama. That's the Yasaka Pagoda: five storeys, 46 m, rebuilt in 1440. Every photo of Kyoto has it somewhere.

Before you climb, look at the coloured charms at Koshin-do, just here: Conan fans know them. Then walk up past the pagoda into Ninenzaka and the steps of Sannenzaka. Mr. Fujii keeps a pottery shop on the way. WASD to walk, Shift to run, E to talk.

steps.text: See the kukurizaru at Yasaka Koshin-do
Climb Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka to Mr. Fujii's pottery shop

quests.title: Three years' luck
talk: Ah, a visitor. These lanes have been preserved by law since 1976: the stone, the wooden fronts, the lattices, no tall signs.
Keep going up Kiyomizu-zaka to the red gate. Ryosen will be at the Deva Gate.

steps.text: Walk up Kiyomizu-zaka to Ryosen at the Deva Gate

quests.title: The red gate
talk: Welcome to Kiyomizu-dera, the Temple of Pure Water. Founded in 778; the halls you see were rebuilt in 1633.
A young pilgrim was asking for the stage. Go through the gate and past the pagoda; she is by the water basin.

steps.text: Find Mika in the temple precinct

quests.title: One truth prevails
talk: You're going to the stage too? Kiyomizu is in Crossroad in the Ancient Capital, and in Crimson School Trip Shinichi and Ran have their photo taken here.
Stand on the stage first, then cross to the Okunoin for the photo. The Otowa Falls are below it: drink from one stream, not three.

steps.text: Stand on the Stage of Kiyomizu
Take the photo from the Okunoin's stage

spots.name: The Stage of Kiyomizu 清水の舞台
lines: About thirteen metres down to the treetops. 清水の舞台から飛び降りる: to jump off the stage of Kiyomizu, as Kyoto says of any bold decision.
The stage is about 200 square metres of hinoki boards. Underneath, keyaki pillars, tied by through-beams. Not a single nail.
In November the whole valley below turns red and gold. Kyoto Tower is the white one on the horizon to the west.

spots.name: Okunoin stage 奥の院
lines: Here is the photo everyone takes: the whole Main Hall on its pillars, the stage hanging over the trees, and the city beyond.
Detective Conan fans come for this view: Kiyomizu is in Crossroad in the Ancient Capital (2003), and Shinichi and Ran pose with the stage behind them in Crimson School Trip (2018).

spots.name: Otowa Falls 音羽の滝
lines: Three streams: learning, love and a long life. Choose one; drinking from all three is greedy, people say.
清水寺, the Temple of Pure Water, is named for this spring.

spots.name: Yasaka Koshin-do 八坂庚申堂
lines: Kukurizaru: cloth monkeys bound hand and foot, so a desire is held in check. Write your wish on one and give up one thing for it.
In Detective Conan's Crimson School Trip, Shinichi and Ran stand here, the charms in front and the Yasaka Pagoda behind.

spots.name: Yasaka Pagoda from Yasaka-dori 八坂の塔
lines: The view of Kyoto: the five storeys of the Yasaka Pagoda at the top of the stone street. 46 metres, rebuilt in 1440.
Come at dusk, when the shops light their lanterns and the pagoda goes dark against the sky.
So this is the stage from Detective Conan!
Crossroad in the Ancient Capital. And in Crimson School Trip, Shinichi and Ran have their photo taken with the stage behind them.
